items.title: Bitcoin slips near $63,500 as traders look past CPI to Fed’s next tests
items.snippet: An in-line inflation print removed a tail risk but gave BTC little reason to rally, leaving Jackson Hole, jobs data and the next CPI release as the market’s next catalysts.
